purpose: Document the static candidate mapping between the dedicated Skillup answer/HOLD response schema and the existing route, helper, Bridge schema, adapter, and static test surfaces without runtime execution.

field_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _trace_id maps response.bridge_trace_id, evidence bridge_trace_id, feedback origin_event_id, request origin_event_id, or feedback_candidate.bridge_trace_id before deterministic fallback
field_mappings.limit: fallback trace is adapter-derived; route integration not executed

field_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _evidence_items projects safe evidence_items and fallback evidence_id/pointer_uri into schema evidence objects
field_mappings.limit: schema validator and route integration not executed

field_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _policy maps raw_leak_pass, rights_pass, sensitivity_pass, and evidence_required_pass or conservative defaults into required policy booleans
field_mappings.limit: defaulted policy values are not runtime policy proof

field_mappings.route_static_surface_candidate: derived by adapter from result_status and hold_reason
field_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _hold_reason_code derives RAW_TEXT_BLOCKED, INTERNAL_PATH_BLOCKED, NO_DB_BOUNDARY, ROLE_ACCESS_DENIED, DENIED_POLICY_BOUNDARY, BRIDGE_RESPONSE_REQUIRED, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, UNSUPPORTED_STATUS_HOLD, or HOLD_REVIEW_REQUIRED
field_mappings.limit: reason-text derivation remains static and brittle; route integration not executed

field_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter collects TRACE_ID_FALLBACK_USED, SOURCE_DENIED_NORMALIZED_TO_ERROR, and EVIDENCE_ARRAY_EMPTY_FOR_HOLD then filters them into schema warnings
adapter emits review_required as result_status != OK

enum_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _normalize_statuses maps source DENIED to schema result_status ERROR and answer_status INVALIDATED with SOURCE_DENIED_NORMALIZED_TO_ERROR warning
enum_mappings.limit: broad DENIED semantic equivalence is not granted; runtime not verified

enum_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _normalize_statuses returns HOLD for HOLD or unknown non-OK statuses not normalized to ERROR

policy_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _policy maps raw_leak_pass or defaults from raw_text_included/internal_path_included false flags
policy_mappings.limit: nearest observed static surface; route integration not executed

policy_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _policy maps rights_pass or defaults from result_status
policy_mappings.limit: nearest observed static surface; route integration not executed

policy_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _policy maps sensitivity_pass or defaults from result_status
policy_mappings.limit: nearest observed static surface; route integration not executed

policy_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter _policy maps evidence_required_pass or defaults from OK status and evidence presence
policy_mappings.limit: nearest observed static surface; route integration not executed

legacy_field_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter uses safe_summary only as fallback source for schema answer when result_status is OK; R9ZLK selected-route tests reject safe_summary as a top-level field
adapter projects safe evidence_id into schema evidence objects; R9ZLK selected-route tests reject top-level evidence_id
adapter maps safe bridge_trace_id candidates into schema trace_id; R9ZLK selected-route tests reject top-level bridge_trace_id
selected route may build feedback_queue_item before adaptation, but adapter top-level allowlist omits it and R9ZLK tests reject it
selected route adds created_at before adaptation, but adapter top-level allowlist omits it and response schema has no created_at property
helper surfaces may expose db_access_executed=false, but adapter top-level allowlist omits it and R9ZLK tests reject it
legacy_field_mappings.limit: no-DB boundary remains static evidence only; runtime not verified

legacy_field_mappings.evidence_basis: adapter maps safe pointer_uri into schema evidence pointer; R9ZLK selected-route tests reject top-level pointer_uri

notes: R9ZMH adds only additive contract/source/schema/test surfaces for deferred persistence.

Selected-route answer/HOLD responses must not expose feedback_queue_item, feedback_candidate, feedback_candidate_required, created_at, db_access_executed, durable queue records, DB status, or repository result objects.
DB-backed persistence execution, DB fixtures, migrations, config/DSN handling, runtime/server startup, real HTTP/browser behavior, and persistence write/read validation require separate approval.
FEEDBACK_QUEUE_PERSISTENCE_PASS remains NOT_GRANTED until a later approved execution gate verifies durable write/read behavior.

limits: route mapping schema labels only modified
